description.subject: A small crocheted figure with a cream fabric face, two black dot eyes and a curved stitched smile.
description.covering: It wears a red crocheted hooded coat with sleeves to the wrist, ruffled cuffs, a flared skirt hem and three gold buttons, over black-and-white striped stockings and black rubber rain boots.
description.posture: It is upright on both feet with its form turned toward the camera and its face looking straight ahead.
description.setting: Outdoors on a bed of smooth tan, grey and brown pebbles in front of a pale green metal garden trough, with a wooden fence behind.
description.materials: Red yarn, cream cotton fabric, black rubber, and stone pebbles, with painted metal behind.
description.anomaly: A thin cream cord hangs from the coat's front tie down to a round amber-yellow ball resting on the pebbles by the boots, like a balloon or toy on a string.
